newsitem.title: USA: LPC-First Chicago loans Scotsman $300 mln.
newsitem.headline: LPC-First Chicago loans Scotsman $300 mln.

text.p: NEW YORK, Feb 5 (LPC) - By the end of February, Agent bank First Chicago NBD Corp will begin syndicating $500 million of loan facilities for Scotsman Industries Inc, banking sources said.
The funds will be used for Scotsman's $300 million acquisition of most of Kysor Industrial Corp and to refinance $90 million of debt, they said.
The seven-year deal will be split between a revolving portion and a term loan, according to bankers.
Pricing was not available, but Scotsman's six-year revolver from 1994 opened at 100 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), a banker said.
